titre: TOEIC Grammar — 06 Les comparatifs et les superlatifs
description: Comparatifs de supériorité, d'infériorité, d'égalité et superlatifs.

questions.question: These two wonderful koalas are by far the …… in the zoo.
questions.explication: Un superlatif de supériorité est nécessaire (mise en avant parmi tous ceux du zoo) : `oldest`.

questions.question: This play is probably the …… I have ever seen in this theater.
Indian cuisine is reputed to be one of the …… in the world.
questions.explication: Après *one of the*, un superlatif de supériorité : `hottest`.

questions.question: Of these two experts, Steve Stoneseifer is definitely …….
questions.explication: Comparaison entre **deux** éléments : comparatif `the more competent`.

questions.question: According to John, between Tarzan and Jane and Romeo and Juliet, the …… moving plot is the second one.
questions.explication: Deux éléments comparés : comparatif de supériorité `more`.

questions.question: Between the secretary and the CEO's assistant, the first one is …….
questions.explication: Deux éléments : comparatif ; ici avec l'article défini pour signifier « la plus efficace des deux » : `the more efficient`.

questions.question: Our plan is to break up with an older supplier because he is no …… competitive.
questions.explication: `No longer` (« ne plus ») : comparatif de supériorité *longer*.

questions.question: This device is …… economic than the other one.
questions.explication: Comparatif de supériorité de deux éléments : `much more economic than`.

questions.question: If you need …… details, please give us a call.
This dish is probably the …… edible that our customers have ever eaten and we have been particularly embarrassed by this unusual situation.
questions.explication: Superlatif d'infériorité, à cause de *particularly embarrassed* (sens négatif) et de *ever* : `the least edible`.
